operations.title: Repair Windows tray cleanup after parent exit
operations.description:
Result: Let the real Windows tray helper finish its own icon and private-cache cleanup after its Node parent ends, while retaining normal Exit and supervised restart behavior.

Starting condition: The existing real Windows smoke already failed its parent-loss cache-removal assertion; real Exit passed separately. The actual PC runs Node v25.2.1 with libuv 1.51.0. Matching Node source assigns non-detached children to a parent-held Windows Job with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE. Current createWindowsTray omits detached:true, so abrupt parent loss can kill the helper before its PowerShell finally block. This is the concrete repair identified by tray-diagnose; the full Windows check remains required. Keep the existing failing Windows assertion as the before-repair result, without rebuilding an artificial failing case.

Locations and inputs: /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/worktrees/scotty-completion, working branch task/scotty-recovered-20261124 at f8b139de8cd48c7c0f42de45d28556ab1db0a310; /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/coordination/results/tray-diagnose.json and tray-repair-instructions.md. Read AGENTS.md, bin/windows-tray.mjs, bin/windows-tray.ps1, bin/server-controller.mjs, scripts/fixtures/tray-process-boundary.mjs, scripts/fixtures/tray-helper.mjs and scripts/test-windows-tray.mjs. Only bin/windows-tray.mjs, scripts/fixtures/tray-process-boundary.mjs and scripts/test-windows-tray.mjs may change. The starting module SHA-256 is fa66d90908397d29722b5a8fcae54f89ec815d5dea54f221af33ce8f9ca4eb5b; the unchanged PowerShell helper SHA-256 is 46c98de97680cad44f8aa70c643a9538941cc0a0a6f5b4f86b6b2f0eae5716fb.

Prerequisites: tray-diagnose (beadrs-9422c821) supplies the concrete source defect. The complete revision-4 plan must be independently accepted and this task materialized before assignment.

Required behavior: Native editing covers title, description, priority with a reason, issue type, notes, status and assignee, plus the existing label and dependency actions. Keep ID, timestamps, claims, recorded history and unrelated records intact. Use the accepted issue-editing-v1 contract in /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/worktrees/bead-completion/research/specs/issue-editing-v1.md. Windows production launchers must have one tray icon with Exit and stop only their own server processes.

Steps:
1. Read the exact diagnosis and current Git status before changing the three allowed files. Match the actual Node release source at https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/4cac2b94bed4bf02810be054e8f63c0048c66564/deps/uv/src/win/process.c to the described parent Job behavior. Preserve all unrelated app and backend code, accepted editing behavior, original helper script and current test assertions.
2. In createWindowsTray add detached:true only to the PowerShell tray-helper spawn. Keep windowsHide:true, shell:false, all three stdio pipes, the retained child reference, READY/EXIT/STOP handling, timeouts and parent watch. Do not call unref on the child or its streams. Add a short comment explaining why the Windows helper must be able to finish cleanup after parent loss. Detached creation does not request CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB; enclosing test Job containment remains required.
3. In scripts/fixtures/tray-process-boundary.mjs record the requested options.detached in the existing tray_spawn event before replacing PowerShell with the synthetic Node helper. Set detached:false explicitly on that POSIX replacement so existing process-group cleanup still contains it. Preserve its pipes, controller behavior, server stop and existing timeout cleanup.
4. In the existing global, serve and start launcher cases in scripts/test-windows-tray.mjs assert the recorded requested detached option is true. Keep every existing hidden-launch, single-helper, real subprocess disposal and server-stop assertion. This fixture checks the requested Windows spawn option; it cannot establish actual Windows Forms cleanup.
5. Inspect the entire change twice on the final same bytes and record two clean author audits. Run git diff --check only; the separately assigned tray-repair-checks task executes the existing launcher suite and lint. Commit only these three allowed files, then record the exact candidate commit, git rev-parse HEAD:bin/windows-tray.mjs blob ID and SHA-256 of git cat-file blob HEAD:bin/windows-tray.mjs bytes. Record unchanged PowerShell helper hash. No placeholder or checkout-newline hash may substitute for the canonical module hash.
6. Publish by an ordinary descendant push to YossiMH/bead-me-up-scotty task/scotty-finish-20261124, leaving main at its existing installer baseline. Return the exact candidate and two audits so cloud checks, installer correction and independent inspection can proceed. This task closes when the candidate is inspectable; installation remains blocked by real Windows results and tray-repair-review.

Required checks and completion: The three-file candidate implements only the diagnosed Windows spawn correction and preserves POSIX fixture cleanup. Both author audits and diff check are clean. Its commit, canonical module blob/SHA-256 and unchanged helper identity are recorded. Actual Windows behavior and the full launcher run belong to separate tasks.

Permissions and limits: Work in the cloud where possible. Root alone uses Emergency Maintenance on the PC and writes canonical task state. Preserve the user's foreground Unreal/VR work: no PC builds, GPU use, visible browser or other UI control, service restarts, broad process termination or unrelated changes. Ordinary PC app checks require at least 3 GiB free physical RAM immediately before launch, hidden BelowNormal processes, a 256 MiB Node heap and a 512 MiB aggregate resident-memory cap covering every owned process. Only the separately accepted browser task uses its specified 96 MiB heaps. Stop the owned check on excess memory, deadline or new foreground resource pressure. Only one PC app check runs at once under bead-edit-pc; retain exact process identities and end only owned processes. Keep the original 954 native records, all 17 existing continuation tasks and their results, the restored store and the 15 modified app files. Never repeat the successful restore, initialize a replacement store, upload private task data or reset another worker's files. Reviewers read source and supplied results; they run no product tests or builds. Reconcile any uncertain mutation before retry and use only legitimately issued claim credentials. A changed candidate must receive its affected checks and independent review before installation; a published candidate alone does not establish working Windows behavior.

Return /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/coordination/results/tray-repair.json with status, source_commits, exact file/blob/SHA-256 identities, changed_files, checks and actual exits, output_paths, open_items and git_result. Name the exercised behavior and remaining limits. Preserve prior failed results and distinguish source inspection from an actual Windows run. Include canonical_module={path,source_commit,git_blob,sha256}, unchanged_helper_sha256 and both author audit results. Root uses these actual values to stage source and bind the installer; do not infer a future commit.

Git completion: Commit only this task's authorized repository changes. Before the checked installation, push backend changes to YossiMH/bead-rs task/bead-finish-20261124 and app changes to YossiMH/bead-me-up-scotty task/scotty-finish-20261124, keeping main at the installer's verified baseline. The recovered app working branch is task/scotty-recovered-20261124; use ordinary descendant publication to its named remote task branch.
